create_time.Description: Time the Instance was created in UTC.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

host_config.Description: A list of hostnames for this instance.

kms_key.Description: Customer-managed encryption key name, in the format projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*.

labels.Description:
Labels as key value pairs.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.Description: The resource name for the Instance.

ca_pool.Description: CA pool resource, resource must in the format of 'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/caPools/{ca_pool}'.

http_service_attachment.Description: Service Attachment for HTTP, resource is in the format of 'projects/{project}/regions/{region}/serviceAttachments/{service_attachment}'.

ssh_service_attachment.Description: Service Attachment for SSH, resource is in the format of 'projects/{project}/regions/{region}/serviceAttachments/{service_attachment}'.

state.Description: The current state of the Instance.

state_note.Description: Provides information about the current instance state.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

update_time.Description: Time the Instance was updated in UTC.
